01 / THE JOB

Learn the drift.
Make the return trip.

STORY CAMPAIGN

One station.
18 reasons to go back.

Recover salvage, reactivate ordered relays, repair damaged systems, and escort the crew through 6 zones. Each four-room mission ends with a guardian: evade its dash, wait for CORE OPEN, then land your pulse.

Choose which middle route comes first. Shut down the next room’s hazard or earn a faster pulse reload. Both rooms are part of the job; the order changes your advantage.

4 pulse rigs · Mission checkpoints · Pause and retry

ARCADE SORTIES

One more sector.
Or one safe payday.

Take on a repeating route of 12 compact maps, with pressure building on later loops. At the dock, bank your haul or continue to the workbench, where you can keep your rig or choose a replacement.

Your hull carries between sectors. Lose it all and the unbanked haul goes with it. A smaller score brought home still beats a fortune left in space.

Changing hazard pressure · Rig choices · Best banked score

03 / YOUR FIRST FLIGHT

Small inputs.
Deliberate moves.

  1. Choose Story, then a job.

    Up/Down selects. A confirms. On the flight deck, Left/Right chooses an unlocked rig. Launch and read the room briefing.

  2. Thrust, drift, brake.

    Tap the D-pad to build momentum. Release it to drift. Hold B to slow down before a turn or to interact beside a station.

  3. Finish the objective. Find the dock.

    Complete the task shown in the briefing, then return beside the actual dock terminal. Delivery is automatic. The bottom edge of a large room is not all safe dock.

04 / PICK YOUR SETUP

Built for Game Boy Color.
Know what is verified.

The native download is Starfall-Salvage-1.1.gbc. It requires color-capable GB/GBC hardware or emulation. It does not run on the original monochrome Game Boy or Game Boy Pocket, and it is not a .gba file.

Copy the ROM to a compatible SD cartridge
  1. Power off the handheld. Remove the cartridge’s SD card and connect it to your computer with a card reader.
  2. Extract the player ZIP. Copy Starfall-Salvage-1.1.gbc into a games folder on the card, outside the cartridge’s system folder.
  3. Eject the card, reinsert it, power on, and choose the game through the cartridge’s normal menu.
  4. Follow the cartridge manufacturer’s save procedure. Keep existing system files and saves.

No custom Chromatic firmware is required for this route. Chromatic USB is not an SD-card passthrough.

Keep your progress: checkpoints, saves, and Arcade

Story saves at checkpoints—not your exact position in the middle of a room. Look for CHECKPOINT SAVED, then choose Continue at the title. SAVE WRITE FAILED means you should not assume the write succeeded.

Arcade saves the best banked score; an unfinished sortie has no persistent resume point. Keep the ROM with its matching battery-save data, and use your emulator or cartridge’s documented import/export procedure.

In this site’s browser game, wait at least two seconds after CHECKPOINT SAVED before leaving. Reloading starts at the title; choose Continue to restore your checkpoint. Saves stay in this browser at this site address, and clearing browser storage removes them. The local site passed a checkpoint reload check. Physical power-off saves and persistence on a future hosted browser edition remain unverified.

What has been tested—and what remains

The exact native 1.1 ROM completed all 18 Story missions and 72 rooms in PyBoy 2.7.0, including all guardians, crew routes, four rigs, both middle-route orders, pause, and Title → Continue. A separate test completed the twelve-map Arcade cycle and sector 13.

The guided clear showed 35:27 on the in-game timer. That counts successful room attempts and excludes menus, pauses, and failed attempts. First-time human completion time has not been measured.

A separate guided browser run completed all 18 missions and 72 rooms at 42:41, rank B, with pauses, retries and a recovery of already-earned progress. Its exact browser build and local save checks are recorded separately from the native result. Clean-clone native and web builds also passed on macOS arm64; generated save-signature and checksum bytes varied. Physical handheld performance, speaker/headphone listening, power-off saves, a future public browser host and blind player testing remain open checks. Music and effects are present, but heard-audio review is still pending.
